Name: MORE Maru Revised - Seasonal - COMPLETED FESTIVAL OUTFITS
Author: smartichoke
Description:
BEST GIRL MARU 

I've got another set of festival outfits for y'all - this time for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9876]stanloona420's version of Maru[/url]! It functions exactly the same as their file, so follow their instructions and use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450?tab=description]Poltergeist's Seasonal Outfit[/url] mod to use the files. I have also included a tutorial under the video tab of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25539]my edits for Haley[/url]! The process will be a little different because Haley had some exceptions to my preferred method of editing, but otherwise its the same steps. Just don't skip stanloona420's portraits! If you have any questions, let me know!! I'm always happy to help!



[b]THIS IS NOT A MOD, THIS IS JUST THE IMAGE FILES.[/b] You will need to replace the images within another mod to use them.



[size=3]There are 2 versions![/size]

[list]
[*]The sprites in V1 are visually matched to the style that stanloona420 used in their files. You will need to download stanloona420's file to complete the set of sprites. I did not edit the sprites for their seasonal outfits.
[/list]
[list]
[*]The sprites in V2 are color matched to the portraits along with some personal preference edits. They are also noseless. There are additional files that contain the noses that can be configured in if you are using Poltergeist's Seasonal Outfit mod! This also includes sprites for the seasonal outfits for consistency.
[/list]
As always, let me know if there are any inconsistencies or issues! I haven't had a chance to do a super in depth look within the game and all of the cutscenes to make sure everything looks right.
